text:
kevin: Quick heads up — PR #9042 modifies request routing and fallback behavior. Per our process, this needs an architecture/design sign-off before merge. RFC: https://rfc.redwood.ai/rfc-321-routing-change (see section 4 for fallbacks). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9042. Planning to merge Thu EOD if we get sign-off. @sanjay @elaine can you take a look? :eyes:
sanjay: I can pick this up today, will focus on the fallback semantics and failure modes. Any unit perf numbers?
kevin: Added microbenchmark numbers to the PR description (throughput/latency for 1k/8k seq). Also pushed a small canary plan in the config file in the branch.
elaine: Review incoming. Two high level asks: 1) we need an explicit canary rollback criterion (latency + error budget), 2) document compatibility with Dedicated autoscaler (todd FYI).
todd: FYI — autoscaler changes look safe but want to see the latency delta under load. If regression >5% for p95 we'll need to gate.
kevin: Understood. Canary config in PR currently: ```canary: steps: - 5% for 1h - 25% for 2h metrics: - p95_latency - error_rate rollback_if: - p95_latency > baseline * 1.05 - error_rate > 0.005```
sanjay: Left inline comments about the fallback ordering and an edge case where KV cache miss + region failover could double-request. Also flagged a tiny doc tweak.
pr-bot: deploy-preview created for branch redwood/pr/9042 — https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/9042 (staging)
elaine: Looks good overall. One doc update and add the rollback threshold for token loss (we don't want silent truncation). After those, I'm +1 pending arch stamp.
sanjay: I can give formal arch ack once the fallback ordering is clarified (commented in PR) and behavior with private deployments is called out. I'll try to finish by 1600 PT.
kevin: Thanks — I'll address comments now and mark the PR with label `arch-gated`. Please ping me if you want a short call, but I think we can do this async.
deploy-bot: Note: staging tests passed for integration suite (18/18).
kevin: tagging this thread — holding merge until either (a) arch sign-off in PR or (b) explicit waiver from @elaine/@sanjay. Will update ETA after comments are addressed. :thumbsup:
